section_summary.extract_value: This section describes data screening procedures for a study, including handling of missing data for height (0.5%), weight (8.2%), and age (8.0%). Improbable BMI values (<12 or >50 kg/m²) representing 2% of the dataset were removed, and Little's MCAR analysis confirmed data were missing completely at random. Missing values were replaced using expectation-maximisation, and no significant univariate or multivariate outliers were detected.
